description: Create: Signalworks is a small Create addon for building more varied redstone control systems. It adds configurable pulse generators, randomized signal routers, signal-strength randomizers, and an oscillator, all designed to fit naturally into Create contraptions and factory logic.

mods.name: Create: Signalworks
mods.description: Create-style signal routing and randomization blocks for NeoForge 1.21.1.

releases.notes:
Initial release for Minecraft 1.21.1 and NeoForge 21.1.x.

- Added Andesite and Brass Pulsers
- Added Andesite and Brass Routers
- Added Andesite and Brass Strength Randomizers
- Added Brass Oscillator
- Added one Threshold Switch-style Create configuration screen per Brass component
- Added Create goggle and wrench integration
- Added Create Ponder scenes for the Pulser, Router, Strength Randomizer, and Oscillator
- Added recipes, loot tables, mining tags, creative-tab entries, and server configuration
- Added persistent, synchronized signal state

Requires Create 6.0.0 or newer.
